$comment: Per-app Google Play content. Copy, fill in, and point PLAYSTORE_CONFIG at it (or name it playstore.config.json). Credentials come from PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Everything under `console` is only rendered into the checklist of Console-only steps — never sent to the API.

listing.title: App Name
listing.shortDescription: One line under the name, 80 characters at most.
listing.fullDescription: The full description. Up to 4000 characters. Plain paragraphs work best; emoji are accepted.
listing.releaseNotes: What changed in this release — written onto the track release, 500 characters at most.

bundle.$comment: Where the signed .aab is. Omit when CI uploads it (Codemagic / GitHub Actions publishing to internal).

images.$comment: icon.png (512×512), feature-graphic.png (1024×500, no alpha), phone/ (2–8 shots, 320–3840 px, long side ≤ 2× short side). Optional tablet-7/ and tablet-10/. A language subdirectory (phone/tr-TR/) overrides the base for that language.

release.$comment: Where `publish` releases the uploaded bundle. Production is reached with `promote`, never here.

console.$comment: Answers for the Play Console forms Google exposes no API for. `check` lists each one until its key is in `done`.

appAccess.instructions: Sign in with the reviewer account. All features are available after login.

contentRating.notes: No violence, sexuality, language, controlled substances or gambling. No user-generated content. Personal information: none shared.
